en.title: Amber Slumber and the Footsteps of a Nameless Cat
en.premise: In the "City That Never Sleeps," where streetlights never dim, the residents are plagued by a faint ringing in their ears and the inexplicable scent of rotting fruit drifting from nowhere. After picking up a "nameless cat" found in a back alley, the protagonist begins to hear "voiceless sounds" lurking within the cracks of daily life. He remains unaware that with every step the cat takes, the very boundaries of the city are being steadily and irrevocably rewritten.

zh.title: 琥珀的微睡与无名之猫的足音
zh.premise: 在灯火永不熄灭的“不眠之城”中，居民们正遭受着隐约耳鸣以及不知从何处飘来的、如腐烂果实般的异味所折磨。主角在小巷中捡到了一只“无名之猫”，从此开始听见了潜伏在日常裂缝中的“无声之声”。他并未察觉，随着猫儿的每一次经过，城市的边界正在一点一滴、无可挽回地被重新改写。
